note: Named executives are limited to individuals explicitly verifiable in sources.json/signals.json — for AZ these are both departures, so engagement priority is low. Buying centers referenced in the research but not tied to a named individual are listed under target_functions WITHOUT fabricated names. FACT / AI HYPOTHESIS / RECOMMENDATION are separated.

executives.name: Leon Wang
executives.fact: Leon Wang, AstraZeneca's former China business head, was formally charged by Chinese authorities more than a year after his detention. H1 2026 China revenue fell 5% at CER under volume-based procurement.
executives.ai_hypothesis: China remains a governance and revenue-pressure zone; commercial activity there carries elevated compliance scrutiny.
executives.indegene_angle: Heightened China compliance sensitivity raises the value of rigorous, auditable MLR and content-governance processes.
executives.why_it_matters: China is both revenue pressure and scrutiny risk right now — governance credibility, not this individual, is what opens the current leadership conversation.
executives.engagement_recommendation: Do not engage this individual. Use the compliance context to position Company's content-governance discipline with current AZ China leadership.

executives.name: Rene Haas
executives.fact: Rene Haas stepped down as an AstraZeneca Non-Executive Director on 30 April 2026 after becoming CEO of SoftBank Group International alongside his Arm CEO role.
executives.ai_hypothesis: The loss of a tech/semiconductor board voice could modestly shift board-level technology perspective; executive commercial leadership is unaffected.
executives.indegene_angle: Minor for services engagement; monitor for a successor with digital/AI focus who could shape AZ technology-partner preferences.
executives.why_it_matters: Board tech perspective is a light-touch watch item — a digital/AI successor would raise the priority of Company's technology track.
executives.engagement_recommendation: No action required. Track board succession for digital/AI advocacy.

target_functions.indegene_angle: Highest-value cross-service target: MedComm indication content, MLR review volume, segmented oncologist Omnichannel.
target_functions.why_it_matters: Four 2026 approvals mean launch-content demand peaks now — approach this buying center before its capacity is locked to incumbents.
target_functions.engagement_recommendation: Bring a tumour-agnostic content-supply-chain proposal spanning the oncology launch portfolio.

target_functions.basis_fact: AZ acquired Modella AI and expanded AI partnerships (Immunai, Algen $555m, Owkin); leadership stated 'the future of the pharmaceutical industry is agentic.'
target_functions.indegene_angle: Both opportunity and competitive threat for DAAI/Tech Solutions — lead with regulated-commercial AI (MLR automation, omnichannel orchestration) to avoid displacement by AZ's own AI stack.
target_functions.why_it_matters: AZ is acquiring AI assets and building its own stack — the window to anchor regulated-commercial AI with them narrows as that stack matures.
target_functions.engagement_recommendation: Present an AI-native commercial-operations offering complementing AZ's R&D AI investments.
